description: An immersive, editorial travel discovery app focused on authentic Indian destinations (mountains, rivers, hidden gems, homestays). Features dynamic location-based theming and AI trip planning.

base_theme.description: Warm, earthy, editorial off-white base to act as a blank canvas before destination selection.

ladakh.vibe: Barren ochre, high altitude stark blue, prayer flags

rishikesh.vibe: Spiritual saffron, river teal, sand, peaceful

manali.vibe: Snow white, pine green, rustic wood, cold breeze

spiti.vibe: Raw desert, muted sand, deep altitude blue, silence

primary_heading.usage: Hero headers, massive impactful destination titles.

secondary_heading.usage: Section titles, storytelling elements, quotes, reviews to give Indian rooted/editorial feel.

body.usage: General body text, readable, modern Gen-Z appeal.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans.
Headings > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Use italic Cormorant Garamond for sub-headings for an elegant magazine look.
Max hero text size: text-6xl (clamp scaling for mobile).

landing_page.structure: Immersive Cinematic Hero (100vh) -> Destination Search Bar Overlay -> Staggered Bento Grid of Top Destinations -> Horizontal Scroll for Hidden Gems/Local Food -> Community Stories (Editorial Layout).
landing_page.hero_overlay: bg-black/30 or bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent for text contrast.

destination_detail.structure: Sticky Glassmorphism Header -> Split Screen or Assymetric layout (Left: Sticky Info/AI Chatbot, Right: Scrollable imagery and homestay/food spots).
destination_detail.background: Dynamic based on destination chosen (changes context variables globally).

ai_trip_planner.structure: Multi-step modern form using framer-motion (NOT generic steps, make it feel like a conversation) -> Output is a Timeline layout (Vertical line connecting days).
ai_trip_planner.cards: Solid background matching theme, subtle 1px border matching primary theme color, NO heavy box-shadow.

component_styles.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Dark/Primary theme color background, light text. Hover: scale slightly (-translate-y-0.5) with a subtle shadow.
component_styles.cards: Neumorphic/Earthy: Flat backgrounds, 1px border (border-black/5 or theme equivalent), generous padding (p-6 or p-8). Avoid generic floating white cards.
component_styles.inputs_and_search: Large, generous padding. Bottom border only (like a clean minimal line) OR large pill shape for the main destination search.
component_styles.ai_chatbot: Floating overlay or side-drawer. Messages shouldn't look like generic WhatsApp bubbles. Use elegant typography, slight background tint (e.g. bg-theme-accent) for AI, outline for user.
component_styles.map_pins: Custom SVG markers using the destination's primary color. Not default Google/Leaflet blue pins.

motion_and_animation.scroll_reveals: Staggered fade-up for list items (homestays, food spots).
motion_and_animation.micro_interactions: Hover states on destination cards should slightly scale the background image and reveal an italicized sub-title.
motion_and_animation.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' separating sections (e.g., 'Wander. Discover. Authentic. Roots.').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Use text shadow over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

general_images.description: Bustling Indian street food market stall for authentic recommendations.
Picturesque mountain village with greenery for homestay sections.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER create generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry, 'Tetris' bento grids (grid-cols-12), and generous negative space.
Use 2x-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12, p-16) than default standard apps to achieve the editorial magazine look.
DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly define transition properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease).
Avoid AI slop: NO purple gradients, NO emoji icons (use lucide-react or phosphor-icons), NO generic Vercel/Stripe looking cards.
Implement a ThemeContext (or Zustand store) that holds the current destination string. Use this context to apply dynamic Tailwind utility classes (or CSS variables) to the root container.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/70 or bg-theme/70.
When building map features, use react-leaflet with a minimal map tile provider (like CartoDB Positron or a custom Mapbox style if free tier is available, avoiding default noisy OpenStreetMap styles).
For the UI, prefer Shadcn/UI for logic (forms, dialogs, select) but heavily strip their default Vercel-like styling to match the organic/earthy theme.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup React app with Tailwind CSS and framer-motion.
2. Install Cabinet Grotesk, Cormorant Garamond, and Satoshi fonts via Fontshare or Google Fonts.
3. Create a Global Theme Provider that switches the CSS variables based on the active destination (default to 'base', switchable to 'meghalaya', 'ladakh', etc.).
4. Build the immersive landing page using the provided hero images. The main search bar should act as the theme trigger.
5. Build the Destination Detail Page utilizing the chosen theme's colors and fonts, featuring a Map section (react-leaflet) and local food/homestay lists.
6. Build the AI Trip Planner multi-step form and timeline output.
